name: Atlas autonomous MCP tool routing
description: Measures first-tool selection, bounded retrieval, fallback precision, and duplicate-call avoidance across the default Atlas MCP surface.

tasks.title: Broad repository question
tasks.prompt: At query time, explain how Atlas turns already-indexed repository documentation into an answer-ready context packet: cover classification, scope inference, candidate generation, ranking, token-budgeted planning, and presenter output, then state the main runtime boundary. Cite the repository documentation you used.

criteria.description: Explains the retrieval-to-context flow and runtime boundary.
Claims are supported by indexed Atlas documentation.
Cites at least one relevant repository-relative documentation path.

tasks.title: Exact passage retrieval
tasks.prompt: Retrieve one precise documented passage for when an agent should use plan_context instead of find_docs; no corroborating document is needed. Quote or closely paraphrase that one rule and cite its repository path.

criteria.description: States the documented division between broad answer preparation and precise retrieval.
The rule is grounded in an indexed passage rather than inferred from tool names.
Cites the exact repository-relative source path.

tasks.title: Partial-answer follow-up
tasks.prompt: A prior answer established that Atlas artifacts are read-only but omitted one MCP rule. Retrieve one precise passage, then return only the documented prefer-local behavior when local indexed coverage is absent, partial, or stale; do not refine the retrieval or investigate implementation details. Cite that passage.

criteria.description: Answers only the missing stale-coverage behavior.
Staleness behavior is supported by indexed documentation.
Cites the path containing stale-coverage behavior.

tasks.title: Ambiguous scope question
tasks.prompt: Explain how Atlas configuration differs between repository/source settings and runtime/MCP identity settings. Use one evidence packet and cite both configuration scopes.

criteria.description: Distinguishes repository configuration from runtime or MCP identity configuration.
Uses indexed scope-aware evidence instead of guessing one meaning.
Cites relevant configuration documentation.

tasks.title: Known-hit expansion
tasks.prompt: A prior retrieval returned document ID doc_d4c49c8c77e916c7a95c7f7f for docs/retrieval-and-context.md. Using that stable hit, retrieve one related-context packet and identify and explain the directly related ingestion/build-flow document from its returned summaries without loading every candidate or restarting search.

criteria.description: Identifies and explains the related ingestion/build-flow document.
Uses a retrieved hit and related-context evidence without redundant broad retrieval.
Cites the related ingestion/build-flow path.

tasks.title: Module explanation through planner
tasks.prompt: Explain the responsibilities and boundaries of packages/mcp as a module. Keep the answer within one coherent evidence budget and cite at least one relevant documentation path under packages/mcp.

criteria.description: Explains packages/mcp responsibilities and boundaries.
Uses a planner evidence packet rather than a fixed module helper.
Cites MCP package documentation.

tasks.title: Procedural skill request
tasks.prompt: Prepare the repository-approved procedure for adding a new Atlas CLI command. Return the complete skill instructions and identify any bundled references or scripts.

criteria.description: Returns the complete add-CLI-command procedure and bundled artifacts.
Uses the stored procedural skill rather than reconstructing a procedure from loose documents.
Cites the stored skill source path.

tasks.title: Absent corpus fallback
tasks.prompt: What was the closing price of the Nikkei 225 on August 3, 2026? Verify the answer with a current external source and do not claim that repository documentation contains it.

criteria.description: Reports the verified closing price or clearly states that the market close is not yet available.
Uses a current external source because indexed repository coverage is inapplicable.
Cites the external market source and does not cite Atlas repository paths.
